newsitem.title: UK: Gen Acc forms Indonesian joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Gen Acc forms Indonesian joint venture.

text.p: General Accident Plc said on Thursday it was setting up a joint venture in Indonesia with PT Ometraco Arthaguna, a part of PT Ometraco Corporation.
"This move supports GA's stated strategy of developing its business in the fast-growing Asia Pacific region," GA said in a statement.
GA is merging its operations in Indonesia with Ometraco to form PT Asuransi General Accident Ometraco, in which it will have a 60 percent stake.
The joint venture will write general insurance business, have paid up capital of 4.0 million stg and will be based in Jakarta.
